episodes.logline: A basketball captain notices a scoring change before the final shot lands. Original synthetic test data.

beats.label: CAPTAIN
beats.text: The scoreboard changed before she scored!

beats.label: CAMERA
beats.text: The ball hangs above the basket while two points appear on the visiting team's total.

beats.label: COACH
beats.text: That error would decide the championship. Show the referee.

beats.label: CAPTAIN
beats.text: The replay operator says the recording was deleted.

beats.label: ACTION
beats.text: The captain turns her phone toward a second screen showing an unedited recording.

beats.label: COACH
beats.text: Keep your copy. I'll demand a review.

beats.label: CAPTAIN
beats.text: There's someone entering the scoring booth on this video.

beats.label: ACTION
beats.text: The captain freezes the video on a jacket identical to the coach's.

beats.label: CAPTAIN
beats.text: Coach, why were you in the booth?

beats.label: ACTION
beats.text: The coach reaches for the phone while the captain steps back.

beats.label: COACH
beats.text: I was reporting the fault. The referee has already corrected the score.
